description: 인천항만공사_항만운영 통계정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. XML 포맷으로 제공되며, 연도, 월, 국가코드, 항코드, 장코드 등의 요청 파라미터를 활용하여 특정 기간 내 항만별 외항선박 입항 건수 및 컨테이너 처리량(TEU)을 조회할 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 인천항, 항만운영 통계, 외항선박, 입항통계, 국적코드. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
